notes.title: 0.3.0 Large-scale Update
notes.content:
[p]Greetings, this is WrongTaken.[/p][p]Originally, I planned to release a small patch as a follow-up to the previous update. However, due to several core system changes and the resulting balance adjustments, this has evolved into a large-scale patch.[/p][p]Here are the key changes:[/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h2][b]Overkill System[/b][/h2][p][/p][p]Overkill, a core mechanic of the game, is a system that grants players a chance to face the boss—aka the formidable—if they eliminate additional enemies even after meeting the stage’s kill quota.[/p][p]This gave players two options:[/p][list][*][p]If you wanted to challenge the formidable, you'd push past the quota and trigger an Overkill.[/p][/*][*][p]If not, you could simply meet the quota and move on to the next stage.[/p][/*][/list][p]However, I noticed some players were going for Overkill without intending to fight the formidable. Why? Likely for the bonus EXP. Once the quota was met, enemies would continue to spawn until Overkill was triggered, allowing players to farm additional experience.[/p][p]That said, skipping the boss battle while farming EXP often resulted in slower character growth. And since regular enemies also provided varying EXP amounts, Overkill became less of a choice and more of an unspoken requirement.[/p][p]To address this, I've [b]removed the "additional kill count" requirement[/b] for Overkill.
Now, simply reaching the stage's kill quota will automatically activate Overkill, spawning portals that allow you to either move on to the next stage or challenge the formidable directly.[/p][p]While the term [i]Overkill[/i] might feel a little out of place now, it still fits in the sense that you’ve taken down [i]more than enough[/i] enemies. (At least, that's how I like to see it.)[/p][p]Check out the new portal designs![/p][list][*][p]The [b]left portal[/b] takes you to the next stage.[/p][/*][*][p]The [b]right portal[/b] leads you straight into the fight against the formidable.[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44820697/fd066f69c54632c5ea45a98d5f0652ce16fd3f7f.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2][b]Swordforce Overhaul[/b][/h2][p][/p][p]Swordforce is a unique ability available only to our protagonist, Bella. It allows her to summon golden phantom blades that strike down enemies with swift, elegant force. By landing basic attacks, Bella builds up her Swordforce gauge. Once filled, it generates Swordforce Orbs—resources that fuel her powerful Swordforce skills. With extremely short cooldowns, this skill line offers a fast-paced, action-heavy playstyle (which is why [i]Agility stat[/i] scales Swordforce damage!).[/p][p]Swordforce skills also hold massive potential against the formidable. Unlike regular enemies, landing basic attacks on the formidable fills the gauge faster, enabling more frequent use of Swordforce skills. And when the formidable is staggered, Bella can unleash a barrage of these skills with zero restrictions.[/p][p]Balancing Swordforce has been one of the toughest tasks. If the gauge fills too quickly, bosses go down too easily. If it fills too slowly, the high-tempo gameplay that defines Swordforce is lost.[/p][p]So, I’ve adjusted key elements of the Swordforce system—fine-tuning them without compromising game balance. Here are the changes:[/p][hr][/hr][p][b]Swordforce System Adjustments[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Max Gauge:[/b] 360 → 160[/p][/*][*][p][b]Base Gauge Gain per Hit:[/b] 45 → 40[/p][/*][*][p][b]Gauge Multiplier (vs. Formidable):[/b] 2x → 1.5x[/p][/*][*][p][b]Gauge Multiplier (vs. Staggered Formidable):[/b] 2x → 1x[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Skill Adjustments: Swordforces[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Pioneer:[/b] Cooldown 0.5s → 0.4s / Increased size[/p][/*][*][p][b]Judgment:[/b] Cooldown 1s → 0.8s[/p][/*][*][p][b]Conviction:[/b] Cooldown 0.8s → 0.7s[/p][/*][*][p][b]Severance:[/b] Cost 4 → 6[/p][/*][*][p][b]Exclusion:[/b] Damage 300% → 520% / Cooldown 1s → 0.8s[/p][/*][*][p][b]Purge:[/b] Cooldown 1s → 0.8s[/p][/*][*][p][b]Retribution:[/b] Cooldown 1s → 0.6s / Increased size[/p][/*][*][p][b]Propagation:[/b] Cooldown 3s → 2s[/p][/*][*][p][b]Fury:[/b] Cooldown 9s → 15s[/p][/*][*][p][b]Inhibition:[/b] Cooldown 12s → 20s[/p][/*][*][p][b]Defiance:[/b] Knockback damage 30 → 20[/p][/*][*][p][b]Drive:[/b] Damage 960% → 880% / Knockback damage 28 → 20[/p][/*][*][p][b]Vigor:[/b] Damage 520% → 600%[/p][/*][*][p][b]Challenge:[/b] Damage 500% → 560%[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p][b]Other Skill Adjustments[/b][/p][p][b]Magics[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Ice Totem:[/b] Cooldown 24s → 21s[/p][/*][*][p][b]Mana Reflection:[/b] Cost 120 → 100 / Cooldown 6s → 5s[/p][/*][*][p][b]Earthquake:[/b] Damage 210% → 420% / Cooldown 40s → 30s[/p][/*][*][p][b]Frost Blade:[/b] Cooldown 50s → 30s[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Arts[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Fang Pull:[/b] Damage 1980% → 2840% / Cooldown 8s → 10s[/p][/*][*][p][b]Jet Stream:[/b] Knockback damage 80 → 90[/p][/*][*][p][b]Swallow Returns:[/b] Damage 100% → 200% / Knockback damage 60 → 40 / Cooldown 10s → 6s[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p]While maintaining game balance is important, my top priority will always be creating an enjoyable experience for you, the players. I promise to avoid unnecessary nerfs that take the fun out of the game. Thank you always for your feedback and passion![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44820697/e7f962060e23a6a0008ae4f9c49bcb10b0902279.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2][b]Visual & Effects Improvements[/b][/h2][p]When I first started developing this game, I was inexperienced in almost every way. And while I've grown more skilled and confident over time, there's one area where I still feel like I'm fumbling: [b]aesthetic sense.[/b][/p][p]If you've been with me since the early versions, you probably remember just how far the UI has come. (It still pains me a little to think of all those hand-made UI assets I scrapped along the way…)[/p][p]But this transformation wouldn't have been possible without your passionate feedback. Every improvement—every overhaul—was driven by your voices. And if there's anything more you'd like to see, I’ll always be ready to listen with one ear and type with both hands.[/p][p]That said, some of you mentioned that the game still feels a bit too static or lifeless. So, I’ve started giving more attention to visual effects and animations.[/p][p]In this update, I’ve added:[/p][list][*][p]New Skill selection animations[/p][/*][*][p]Status message popups[/p][/*][*][p]New hit effects[/p][/*][*][p]Low-HP (near-death) visual indicators[/p][/*][/list][p]And that’s just the beginning—many more visual touches and effects are on the way.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44820697/88ffcf02f013f4486b17a090c6d4e7b9e47b3e4b.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]That wraps up this update.[/p][p]I know this game doesn't have a large player base—likely due to my own limitations as a developer—but if even a few of you can enjoy this patch and have fun with it, that alone makes me incredibly happy.[/p][p]Thank you, always![/p]

notes.title: 0.2.0 Patch Notes
notes.content: [p]Hello, this is WrongTaken.[/p][p]This patch includes significantly more changes compared to previous updates, so I’m reaching out with this detailed announcement.[/p][p]I have incorporated as much of your valuable feedback as possible from past exhibitions and online surveys.[/p][p][/p][h2][b]UI (User Interface)[/b][/h2][p]The game's UI has been completely redesigned.[/p][p]There was a lot of feedback stating that the visibility of elements like [b]HP[/b], [b]stamina[/b], [b]mana[/b], and [b]swordforce gauges[/b] in the old UI was poor.[/p][p]So I have updated it as shown in the following screenshots.[/p][p][b]Before[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44820697/12bfcf10987fad7e1e6b5a2bb4d116743408d2ef.png"][/img][/p][p][b]After[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44820697/f529e82d320e7eccd0d93c8ae9cffec0fccd5b5f.png"][/img][/p][p]I have reduced the amount of screen space the UI takes up and widened the field of view, allowing players to enjoy a more open and expansive combat experience.[/p][p]This change is intended to provide a more comfortable and immersive play environment.[/p][p]If you have any feedback on the new UI, I’ll do my best to reflect it in the game.[/p][p][/p][h2][b]Difficulty[/b][/h2][p]First of all, I apologize for the previously high level of difficulty.[/p][p]Since I had a limited number of testers, I personally adjusted the game balance while playing it myself. However, since I’m quite familiar with the game, the difficulty settings ended up being too high for new players.[/p][p]Because of this, many players couldn’t complete all the content.[/p][p]I have now adjusted the overall game difficulty to ensure that new users can also enjoy the game more easily.[/p][p][/p][h2][b]Stats[/b][/h2][p]Previously, Bella could use [b]stat points[/b] to increase her [b]stats[/b] every time she [b]leveled up[/b].[/p][p]From now on, you will only be able to allocate [b]stat points[/b] every 4 levels (e.g., level 4, 8, 12…).[/p][p]The old system contributed to the high difficulty—constantly opening menus to allocate points disrupted immersion, but ignoring it made it hard to keep up with increasingly stronger enemies.[/p][p]Now, similar to how new skills are unlocked, a pop-up will appear every 4 levels allowing you to allocate [b]stat points[/b].[/p][p]Additionally, I have reduced Bella’s [b]base stats[/b] but tripled the scaling efficiency of each stat to increase their overall impact.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Stat Point Acquisition Timing[/b][/p][list][*][p]Before: Gained on every level up[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Now: Gained every 4 levels[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]Stat Points per Gain[/b]: 3 → 4[/p][p][/p][p][b]Base Stats Changes[/b][/p][p][b]Health[/b]: 9 → 3[/p][p][b]Strength[/b]: 12 → 4[/p][p][b]Clarity[/b]: 7 → 2[/p][p][b]Agility[/b]: 11 → 4[/p][p][b]Violence[/b]: 9 → 3[/p][p][b]Grit[/b]: 11 → Removed[/p][p](Note: While [b]base stats[/b] have been reduced, the effectiveness per point has tripled, so the overall impact is about the same.)[/p][p][/p][h2][b]Grit Stat Removed[/b][/h2][p]The "Grit" stat has been removed.[/p][p]Originally, it was intended to increase armor and poise, offering better HP efficiency and resistance to Dots.[/p][p]However, its function overlapped too much with the Health stat, and having six different stats ended up confusing players rather than providing meaningful choices.[/p][p]Items that previously boosted Grit now enhance appropriate defensive attributes (such as Health, HP, or Armor).[/p][p]Additionally, increasing the Health stat will now also increase armor.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Effect of Increasing Health[/b][/p][list][*][p]Before: +11 HP[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Now: +33 HP, +1 Armor[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2][b]Map Structure Changes[/b][/h2][p]Before facing the formidable, many of the stages had too many obstacles and terrain elements, making it hard to deal with multiple enemies.[/p][p]To address this and balance difficulty, I have removed many of the obstacles that hindered Bella’s movement, allowing players to engage in combat more smoothly.[/p][p](Some maps have been completely redesigned.)[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44820697/2d5c16dee7481c63d170859f1f0c8622ffdb6efb.png"][/img][/p][p]I have prioritized and updated the most critical elements first, and further UI patches are planned.[/p][p]I will continue to make regular updates to ensure the game continues to grow and improve for players.[/p][p]Thank you![/p]

notes.title: The harsh adventure will begin on January 20th
Thank you for your attention on 'Berserk High' during Steam Next Fest
notes.content:
First of all, I'd like to thank you whose wishlist or played my first game.
Despite there being thousands of well-made games during Steam Next Fest, choosing my game makes me happy.

Honestly, I'm introverted, so I used to hesitate to register my game on Steam Next Fest. However, promoting to SNSs or communities like Reddit is extremely hard for me, so I registered the 'Berserk High' on Fest rather than social network promotion.

Thanks to all dearest players, my wishlist numbers luckily soared more than I expected after Steam Fest, which makes me confident.
The 'Berserk High' will be upgraded every day, and I hope to watch you enjoy the completed game in the future.
Also, I will use Discord and YouTube soon to share my work progress or communicate with players.

If you want to give me any feedback, please let me know through this page.

Thank you!

notes.title: The Previous title 'Overkill' is now changed into 'Berserk High'
notes.content:
The 'Overkill' is gone, and 'Berserk High' has come. (Only title has changed, not game systems)

There are major graphical upgrades, so landscape in map now looks better. (Enemies who confront Bella also become fancy!)

Now players can fight with the bosses called The Formidable. You must take care of yourself and check your equipment or consumable items for battle with powerful enemy.

There are 2 of the formidable and a hero in Demo. I don't want to suggest you to fight with the hero, however if you are eager to challenge or get thrill, it is up to you.

You can download Demo and play during Steam Next Fest and if you feel difficult with the game, I recommend you to watch Steam streaming service in Steam Next Fest page. 

Thank you!
